info.name: Fuel Route Planner
info.description: POST /api/route/plan/ returns the route, cheapest fuel stops (500 mi range, 10 mpg) and total fuel cost. GET /api/route/map/ draws the same plan on a map. start/finish accept "City, ST", "lat,lng" or a free text address.
